text.tspan: Reported polio cases and deaths United States, 1910 to 2025
The reported figures include both wild- and vaccine-derived poliovirus infections that occurred indigenously and

tspan.tspan: Public Health Reports (1942); United States Census Bureau (1945); Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (2026)
Only cases and deaths from acute polio infections are included. Until 1983, the data includes all reported polio cases; from 1984,

text.tspan: paralytic cases only. Case counts for 2024 and 2025, and the death count for 2025, are provisional.
